def z85_encode(data, alphabet=REVZ85):
    n = leading_zero_bytes(data)
    if n == len(data):
        return alphabet[0] * n
    rest = data[n:]
    value = int.from_bytes(rest, 'big')
    encoded = ''
    while value > 0:
        value, rem = divmod(value, 85)
        encoded = alphabet[rem] + encoded
    leading = alphabet[0] * n
    return leading + encoded
